text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace proved herself to be a true 
"Ace" and claimed victory in the Arima 
Kinen. She also achieved the great feat of 
being named Best Senior Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace refused to accept any of it 
and kept running. Not the "common sense" 
that no one can rival the girls of that 
"different world." Nor the "reality" that 
the have-nots simply fade away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gallant figure became the people's 
hope. And she will continue to lead 
everyone forward, waving the banner of 
hope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No one doubts it anymore. The "Ace" of the 
Umamusume world has been born right here.
